review_notes: I read the whole file, which has two theorems. The first is an a.e. representation proof: a monotonicity subset, `filter_upwards`, and one specialization of the classical equation. The second is an energy-integrability proof: smoothness of the split, continuity of the gradient and Laplacian-gradient pieces, then `congr` with the a.e. representation. The second theorem reuses the first theorem's statement as a lemma, so there is no duplicated reasoning. The only repeated items are the short `(iterateSpatialSplits w).filter (fun p => !p.1.isEmpty)` expression and the type annotations. Those are too small to count as repeated proof machinery. I grepped Section4 and found the `ae_restrict_mem iterate_timeCube_isOpen.measurableSet` idiom in many files. It is routine one-line boilerplate, so a shared lemma would be a thin wrapper. I did not inspect each of those uses for deeper shared structure. I found no justified finding under this rubric.
